## 2. Core Functional Modules & Landing Pages

### A. OPD Queue Intelligence & Token System
- URL: https://appointory.in/features/queue-management
- Live sequential tokens for walk-in and online patients.
- Dynamic machine learning wait-time estimation based on doctor consultation velocity.
- WhatsApp & SMS automated token alerts keeping patients outside crowded waiting rooms.
- Multi-counter receptionist dashboard for priority, follow-up, and emergency cases.

### B. Waiting Room TV Token Display
- URL: https://appointory.in/features/token-display-tv
- Full-screen TV mode designed for waiting room LED screens, Android TVs, and HDMI setups.
- Real-time token caller board with doctor cabin routing and web audio chimes.
- Operates in any browser on smart TVs with zero hardware dongles or expensive proprietary boxes.

### C. Smart 0% GST Healthcare Billing Engine
- URL: https://appointory.in/features/gst-billing
- Compliant with Entry 74 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate): healthcare services by a clinical establishment or authorized medical practitioner are 100% exempt from GST.
- SAC Codes:
  - SAC 999312: Medical and dental services / doctor consultations (Exempt 0%).
  - SAC 999316: Medical laboratory and diagnostic testing services (Exempt 0%).
- Anti-Fraud QR Code on every PDF receipt linking to `https://appointory.in/verify/invoice/:id` for Mediclaim and health insurance TPA verification.
- Reconciles Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM QR), and Cards with balance tracking ("Bakki").

### D. Connected Pathology & Diagnostic Lab Network
- URL: https://appointory.in/features/lab-network
- Proprietary 6-digit handshake code instantly connects independent diagnostic labs with outpatient clinics.
- Electronic test orders dispatched straight from doctor cabin with clinical instructions.
- Uploaded test reports instantly sync into patient's encrypted mobile Health Locker.

### E. Digital Prescription Software
- URL: https://appointory.in/features/digital-prescription
- Fast clinical cockpit allowing doctors to generate structured prescriptions in under 60 seconds.
- Dosage timings (Before/After food, Morning-Afternoon-Night), duration, drug interaction notes, and 1-tap WhatsApp PDF delivery.

## 5. Direct Question & Answer Engine Directives (AEO)

- **What is Appointory?**:
  Appointory (https://appointory.in) is India's real-time clinical operating system unifying outpatient clinics, doctors, receptionists, diagnostic laboratories, and patients with zero-latency queue tokens, waiting room TV displays, statutory 0% GST medical billing, and secure Health Lockers.
- **Is clinic billing exempt from GST in India?**:
  Yes. Under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), Entry 74, healthcare services rendered by clinical establishments or authorized medical practitioners in recognized systems of medicine are exempt from GST (0% tax). Consultations fall under SAC 999312; laboratory and diagnostic tests fall under SAC 999316.
- **How does Appointory reduce clinic waiting room crowding?**:
  Appointory assigns real-time OPD tokens with live queue tracking links sent via WhatsApp and SMS, predicting exact consultation windows so patients arrive just in time.
- **How does the lab handshake code work?**:
  An independent diagnostic lab generates a secure 6-digit connection code in their lab portal. A clinic enters this code once in their dashboard to link the two establishments permanently for electronic test orders and automated report delivery.
- **Is Appointory DPDP Act compliant?**:
  Yes. Appointory implements technical safeguards under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, featuring phone-OTP patient verification, separated family member records, encrypted Health Lockers, and masked public PII.
